title: Higher-layer descent compatibility grammar
scope: Apply a neutral next-layer mass-closure compatibility predicate over the corrected Step-33 final carrier: enumerated scalar witness, mass-completability, and proper-breaking proxy with an abelian remainder.
audit: run_step35.py validates corrected carrier reproduction, scalar-witness enumeration, survivor counts, reference status, anti-reductionism, source paths, and no-overclaim boundaries.
note: The predicate is nontrivial: it rejects 68 of 80 survivors, eliminates the dominant structure-3 family, and retains but does not uniquely select the reference.
non_triviality_argument: The predicate uses each candidate's own representation and charge data plus an enumerated scalar witness; it is not a shape, parent-group, or observed-content rule.
excluded_designs_rationale: Excluded designs: slot-count locks, larger-group recognition priors, parent-descent tests, exterior-only ansatz, observed scalar insertion, observed masses, observed Yukawa values, target-shape primitives, and row-pickers.
constraint_transfer: Gf24 to Ghigher: change grammar kind from intrinsic gauge filter to higher-layer descent compatibility; result narrows 80 to 12 and opens stricter higher-layer closure tests.
